features.name: College of Valor
features.description: When you join the College of Valor at 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. You can perform the somatic components of your bard spells even when you have a weapon or shield in one or both hands. Additionally, a creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made.

features.name: Valor Bard Spells
features.description: The following spells are added to the bard spell list for you when you reach the appropriate bard level.

features.name: Enchanted Blade
features.description: At 3rd level, whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one weapon that you are proficient with and that lacks the two-handed property. When you make an attack with that weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. This benefit lasts until you finish your next long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: At 11th level, you learn to shield others in battle. When an attack roll is made against a creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you, that creature can use its reaction to expend the die and gain a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn, including against the triggering attack.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: At 17th level, you have mastered the art of weaving spellcasting and weapon use into a single harmonious act. When you use your action to cast a bard spell that does not deal damage, you can make two weapon attacks as a bonus action.
